question.en: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?
question.zh: 塔捷耶夫为什么这样冒生命危险？

sentences.en: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?
sentences.zh: 塔捷耶夫为什么这样冒生命危险？
波兰科学家哈罗恩·塔捷耶夫
sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 一生都在研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。

chunks.x: in all parts of the world

sentences.en: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
sentences.zh: 1948年，他到刚果的基伍湖去观察一座新火山，后来他把它命名为基图罗。

sentences.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
sentences.zh: 在火山猛烈喷发时，塔捷耶夫把营地设在离它很近的地方。

sentences.en: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs,
sentences.zh: 虽然他拍到了一些极好的照片，

sentences.en: he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
sentences.zh: 但他不能在火山附近待太久。

sentences.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
sentences.zh: 他注意到一股岩浆正向他流来。

chunks.x: that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him

sentences.en: It threatened to surround him completely,
sentences.zh: 眼看就要把他完全包围，

sentences.en: but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
sentences.zh: 但塔捷耶夫及时逃脱了。

sentences.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
sentences.zh: 他等到火山平静下来，两天后又回去了。

sentences.en: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro
sentences.zh: 这一次，他设法爬进了基图罗火山口，

sentences.en: so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
sentences.zh: 塔捷耶夫经常这样冒生命危险。

sentences.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们的有关活火山的情况比任何活着的人都多。
